selection.rule: include every eligible run with tail_proxy_sec >= 1800, then add two evenly spaced chronological controls per canonical UTC time-of-day bucket

semantics.queue_seconds: max(0, started_at - created_at); may include needs: dependency waiting
semantics.workflow_proxy_seconds: updated_at - run_started_at; completion proxy, not pre-run queue
semantics.per_run_job_wall_seconds: max(job completed_at) - min(job created_at); do not sum parallel jobs
semantics.coverage: job timings cover the tail-enriched 50-run sample; all 113 run-level proxies are from the bounded census
semantics.historical_runner_labels: all 400 selected jobs were ubuntu-latest; this does not describe current runner capacity
semantics.causal_limit: timing correlation identifies long jobs/steps, not why they are slow or whether an optimization is safe
